cards.summary: A list of records for cards, with the page it is when the host pages it.

item.summary: One record: a title, and optionally a text, an address, a picture, a date and a badge.

menu.summary: Links of a menu, one level of children under each.

pagination.summary: Where a paged list is: the page, how many there are, and the total. A runtime state a list publishes.

section_title.summary: The title of a section and a line under it.

fields.summary: Which fields a source has: [{key, label, type?}].

preview.summary: Data for a binding to show in the editor, in the binding's shape (demo data when the source is not reachable).

sources.summary: Which sources give this shape: [{id, label, shapes, presets?}].

alignment.summary: How the block's text lines up, per screen.

background.summary: The block's fill: a surface or container colour role.

breakout.summary: The block leaves its container and spans the page's width (container-breakout).

grid.summary: The block's children in columns, with a gap, per screen.

spacing.summary: Space inside the block, above and below, and at the sides, per screen.

visibility.summary: The block is hidden on the screens where it is set.

width.summary: How wide the block's content stands: a text measure, the page container, a wider container or the full width.
